title: Now install something on your own computer
drDigitalIntro:
You have searched, installed, granted permissions, updated and deleted apps in the practice store. Now use the real one.
• Open your computer's app store and search for something you actually want.
• Before installing, read what permissions it asks for. An app that wants your contacts to show the weather is asking for too much.
• Install it, open it once, and see whether you use it again in a week.
• Delete an app you have not opened in months. Storage is easier to free this way than any other.
drDigitalSuccess: Installing and deleting are both one click, and both are reversible.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then open the app store on your own computer.
